description: Submission of the Money or Value Transfer Service Providers Regulations No.1 of 2025, for approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In order to ensure compliance with the Anti-Money Laundering/Countering the Financing Terrorism, Money or Value Transfer Service Providers Regulations No.1 of 2024 have been published under the provisions of Payment and Settlement Systems Act, No.28 of 2005. Accordingly, only the companies registered under the provisions of the Companies Act, No.7 of 2007, other than a company limited by guarantee, an offshore company or a foreign company, are eligible to obtain a certificate of registration under the said Regulations. However, it has been observed that foreign money or value transfer service providers are engaged in providing their services through their agents in Sri Lanka and such institutions are unable to obtain a certificate of registration from the Central Bank of Sri Lanka as per the regulations currently in force. Accordingly, the Money or Value Transfer Service Providers Regulations No.1 of 2025 has been published by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2468/06 dated 2025-12-23, amending the Money or Value Transfer Service Providers Regulations No.1 of 2024, so that legal provisions would be provided for foreign money or value transfer service providers as well to obtain a registration certificate. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
